before: A w:noWrap cell with an auto width wrapped its text inside the grid column width.
after: The column holds the cell's unwrapped text with its margins. Other columns give way, or the table grows past w:tblW when they hold their own widths. Shared document state and operations are unchanged.
reason: The change is confined to layout. Replicas compute the same layout from the same tree, and saved documents keep the same XML.
